_comment: Copy to appsettings.local.json (gitignored) or set the equivalent environment variables (Climber__Pin, Climber__SurplusApiKey, SURPLUS_API_KEY, Climber__OpenRouterApiKey, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, ...). Never commit real keys. Set Climber:Pin to a non-default value to expose the dashboard on the LAN; the shipped default PIN is loopback-only.
